title: RPG Plus
description: The Best RPG Modpack with 170+ Mods that transform your experience while staying grounded to the Vanilla game! Distant Horizons included
body:
![RPG Plus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4de08285bb9afd74035aa35de2b69c31f7ba694.png) [![Github](https://shieldcn.dev/github/TheSpiffyOne/RPG-Plus/release.svg?size=default&logo=lu%3AGithub)](https://github.com/TheSpiffyOne/RPG-Plus/releases) [![Discord](https://shieldcn.dev/discord/1254903815526813766.svg?variant=branded&size=default&logo=discord&brand=discord)](https://discord.gg/dh7jVus9ZX) [![Donation](https://shieldcn.dev/badge/donate%20<3.svg?size=default&theme=emerald&logo=ri%3APiMoneyWavy&labelTextColor=ffffff)](https://app.lava.top/spiffy?tabId=donate) # ![RPG Plus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d8d92e1ec59b1d64cb423fdfc80976c5c838848.png)RPG Plus - The Reimagined Minecraft Experience The **RPG Plus Modpack** aims to immensely improve your Minecraft experience. It makes Minecraft more exciting to play by providing incredible new Features and Gameplay as well as new stunning Visuals. This makes Minecraft less boring — you get a playthrough that is more unique and fun to play! This Modpack contains over **170+ MODS** all working together to create a _MINECRAFT 2.0_ experience. It also includes **DISTANT HORIZONS 3.3** with **7 SHADERS** for your choosing, among other terrain mods which will make your world seem vast and endless. ## ✨The RPG Plus Experience The early game is not easy and provides RPG-like gameplay where you are fighting for survival. As you progress, you get better gear and level points, which you can use to upgrade your skills in order to get better gear. Explore vast dungeons, slay tough enemies and create unique memories! The current progression system is **WIP** and I would love to hear your feedback! ### 📌Features
  • Character Leveling System
  • Picturesque Landscapes (Distant Horizons, Terralith, Tectonic)
  • Quests (Optional)
  • New Dungeons and Bosses
  • Improved Flora and Fauna Variety
  • Overhauled Progression System
  • Lore-Friendly Map System
  • New Armors, Items, ect.
  • And More!
## ![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c25f3d1fb5feeb715144eb16de0201076ef74b2.png)Discord Server If you have any Issues, Questions, Feedback or just want to hang out — join our Discord Server! https://discord.gg/dh7jVus9ZX ## ❓FAQ
  • Q: How Do I play with this Modpack? **A:** You have to install the Modrinth Launcher and download the pack there
  • Q: I have an issue where can I get help? **A:** Join our linked Discord and visit the #help-required thread
  • Q: My World is loading slow why? **A:** There are over 170+ mods, they all require to be loaded + Distant Horizons takes some time to load, so please be patient
  • Q: I want to add a different shader, how do I do that? **A:** Distant Horizons requires compatible shaders which are included in the pack, if you want a different shader that isn't included in the Modpack, you will have to find one that is compatible and add it yourself
  • Q: Why is my game Low FPS? **A:** This might be due to your Java memory limit, which you can change in Modrinth (the default is very low, change it based on the amount of RAM you have). You can also tweak Distant Horizons and the Shader (if you have one turned on) settings to be less intensive on your computer
  • Q: Where do you get all these mods/are they official or modified? **A:** All of the mods, resource packs, shaders are from Modrinth or CurseForge Official Sources. I do not modify any of the items I add to the Modpack, I am simply creating a Modpack of existing content posted by the amazing Creators
